scope: DETERMINISTIC SERIAL MODEL; atomic metadata actions assumed, not implemented synchronization; no IRQ, DMA, cache, RTOS or transport emulation

split_acquire: writer reuses unpinned slot 0 and publishes generation 3
reader stores pin=0; stale generation 1 points to rewritten bytes
copy_only_lock: lock: full copy A to fixed source; unlock
lock: full copy B to fixed source; unlock
cooperative_watchdog: same task watchdog callback never reached
lock_across_worker: reader borrow and lock cannot be released by cooperative caller

conditional_invariants: no write to published or pinned slot
fixed composition and full reader interval participate in exclusion
close rejects new work, drains reader/writer before storage release
